summary.goal: Replace ideation-ui's simple status bar with planner-ui's richer agent dock (avatars, progress rings, question bubbles).

acceptance_criteria.description: Ideation StatusBar component replaced with planner-ui's StatusBar pattern
AgentAvatar components (from planner-ui) render with progress rings showing step completion
AgentActivityDot (from planner-ui) shows working (green), needs_input (yellow), blocked (red) states
Question bubbles pop up from agent avatars for 10-15s (blocking: 30s, FYI: 8s), then shrink to badge
useAgentOrchestration hook (from planner-ui) polls agent status every 5s
useQuestionNotifications hook (from planner-ui) manages bubble lifecycle
Connection status indicator appears when relay disconnects (hidden when connected)
Pending question count badge shows on status bar when items waiting
Colors adapted to tend's earth-tone palette (green=moss, red=brick, yellow=clay)

observations: The ideation-ui status bar is minimal (session status + specialist count)
planner-ui's StatusBar is feature-rich with agent avatars, progress rings, question bubbles, and connection indicators
Components to copy: AgentAvatar, AgentActivityDot, useAgentOrchestration, useQuestionNotifications, ChatBubble pattern from planner-ui
The question pipeline: useQuestionQueue (SSE polling) → useQuestionNotifications (auto-advance bubble) → status bar display
Timing behavior: blocking questions stay 30s, normal 15s, FYI 8s before collapsing to badge
Progress rings visualize step completion percentage per agent
Activity dots use color to signal state, not just decoration
questions: Should we preserve ideation's specialist count or replace with agent count?
Do we need session status in tend's status bar or is that redundant with project state?
Should question bubbles be dismissible or only auto-collapse?

steps.title: Remove ideation StatusBar and copy planner-ui StatusBar pattern
steps.description: Delete packages/tend/src/components/StatusBar.tsx (ideation version). Copy packages/planner-ui/src/components/status/StatusBar.tsx → packages/tend/src/components/status/StatusBar.tsx. Copy AgentAvatar.tsx and AgentActivityDot.tsx components from planner-ui.

steps.title: Copy useAgentOrchestration hook and wire to status bar
steps.description: Copy packages/planner-ui/src/hooks/useAgentOrchestration.ts → packages/tend/src/hooks/useAgentOrchestration.ts. Polls agent status every 5s. Wire to StatusBar to display agent avatars with progress rings. Update API endpoint to fetch project-scoped agents.

steps.title: Copy useQuestionNotifications and ChatBubble for question pipeline
steps.description: Copy packages/planner-ui/src/hooks/useQuestionNotifications.ts → packages/tend/src/hooks/useQuestionNotifications.ts. Copy ChatBubble component. Configure timing: blocking 30s, normal 15s, FYI 8s. Wire to StatusBar for bubble rendering. After timeout, shrink to badge.

steps.title: Add connection status indicator
steps.description: In StatusBar: add connection indicator (copy from planner-ui StatusBar if exists). Hidden when relay WebSocket connected. Shows on disconnect with reconnection state. Uses RelayContext connection status.

steps.title: Adapt all colors to tend's earth-tone palette
steps.description: In StatusBar, AgentAvatar, AgentActivityDot: replace planner-ui's neon colors with tend palette. Moss green (#4a7c59) for working, brick red (#b54a3a) for blocked, clay (#c4703e) for needs_input. Update progress ring colors. Test in both light and dark themes.

architect.source_components: planner-ui: StatusBar, AgentAvatar, AgentActivityDot, useAgentOrchestration, useQuestionNotifications
